ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is an adjacent two-carbon skeleton, one carbon of which is connected to R and SO2Ar, and the other carbon is connected to R1 and downward to an oxygen atom. This oxygen atom is then connected to the lower-right central carbon; the central carbon is connected to a methyl group, a negatively charged oxygen, and an oxygen leading to an acetate fragment. The acetate fragment on the right can be regarded as O-C(=O)-CH3. The curved arrows in the figure indicate electron movement, and this problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: According to the specified method, start from the carbon bearing R1, use * to represent R1, so it is written as *C(...). The oxygen substituent of this carbon is O-C; this central carbon bears methyl, [O-], and O-C(=O)CH3, so the branch is written as OC(C)([O-])OC(C)=O. Continue to the adjacent carbon, which bears R and is represented by C(*), and is connected to SO2Ar; according to the method, write Ar as phenyl, namely S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1. Combining gives the SMILES: *C(OC(C)([O-])OC(C)=O)C(*)S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1.

method.method_draft: Trace the structure from the R1-bearing carbon. Write `*C(...)` for that carbon with R1 as `*`. Add its oxygen substituent as the branch `OC(C)([O-])OC(C)=O`, corresponding to O–C bearing methyl, O−, and O–C(=O)CH3. Continue along the carbon skeleton to the adjacent carbon as `C(*)`, representing the R substituent, and attach the sulfone phenyl group as `S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1`. Combine these pieces to obtain `*C(OC(C)([O-])OC(C)=O)C(*)S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1`.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个相邻二碳骨架，其中一个碳连有 R 和 SO2Ar，另一个碳连有 R1，并向下连到一个氧原子。该氧原子再连到右下方的中心碳；中心碳连有一个甲基、一个带负电的氧，以及一个通向乙酸酯片段的氧。右侧乙酸酯片段可看作 O-C(=O)-CH3。图中的弯箭头表示电子移动，本题要求忽略箭头。推理：按指定方法从带 R1 的碳开始，用 * 表示 R1，所以写作 *C(...)。该碳的氧取代基为 O-C，该中心碳带甲基、[O-] 和 O-C(=O)CH3，因此支链写作 OC(C)([O-])OC(C)=O。继续到相邻碳，该碳带 R，用 C(*) 表示，并连接 SO2Ar；按方法将 Ar 写成苯基，即 S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1。合并得到 SMILES：*C(OC(C)([O-])OC(C)=O)C(*)S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the molecular graph in the image: a two-carbon fragment bearing R/R1 placeholders, the left carbon bonded to SO2Ar, the right carbon bonded through O to a tertiary carbon that also bears CH3, O−, and an O-acetyl group; ignore the curved arrows.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the requested output is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure and that arrows in the drawing should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent unspecified R and R1 groups as wildcard atoms `*`; interpret `Ar` attached to sulfone as phenyl `c1ccccc1`; encode sulfone as `S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1`; encode the negatively charged oxygen as `[O-]`; omit stereochemistry because none is specified.
